items.title: Define a single material dirty gate policy table
items.context: Create one source-of-truth policy mapping each DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES entry to a blocking/passing decision and a human-readable audit reason. material_source_changes / fixture_changes / unexpected_dirty_files stay blocking. koala_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes pass with audit notation. Surface the table in core, not duplicated per gate.
items.userSees: User imports evaluateDirtyGate from packages/main/src/core/dirty-gate-policy.ts and sees a deterministic shape: { allPass: boolean; blockingCounts: { material_source_changes: N, fixture_changes: N, unexpected_dirty_files: N }; passingCounts: { koala_metadata_changes: N, runtime_artifact_changes: N, declared_artifact_changes: N }; auditEvents: AuditEvent[] }. DIRTY_GATE_POLICY table is a const object listing all 6 DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES with explicit { blocking: boolean; auditReason: string } values; an exhaustive runtime guard throws if any future enum value is missing from the table.

happy.desc: evaluateDirtyGate({koala_metadata_changes:[entry],runtime_artifact_changes:[entry],declared_artifact_changes:[entry]}) returns allPass=true, passingCounts populated, auditEvents non-empty

edge.desc: evaluateDirtyGate(empty classification) returns allPass=true, blockingCounts/passingCounts all 0, auditEvents empty (no audit when nothing happened)

adversarial.desc: If a new category is added to DIRTY_WORKTREE_CATEGORIES but missing from DIRTY_GATE_POLICY table, evaluateDirtyGate throws with explicit message naming the missing category (preMortem #1 anchor)

DIRTY_GATE_POLICY entries for material_source_changes, fixture_changes, unexpected_dirty_files have blocking:true; only koala_metadata_changes / runtime_artifact_changes / declared_artifact_changes have blocking:false

section (4) — empty classification → allPass=true, summary blocking=0; passed=0, zero audit events
assertPolicyCovers throws when category missing; smoke section (1) calls assertPolicyCovers via doesNotThrow assertion + length invariant
section (1) directly asserts each of the 6 DIRTY_GATE_POLICY blocking flags

items.title: Consume the policy from TEST, DONE, and validate side-effect guard
items.context: Replace inline 'any dirty blocks' checks in story-advance (TEST pre-check + DONE gate) and validation-executor (side-effect guard) with calls into the shared policy table. Output must list per-category counts with the audit reason so users see blocking=material+fixture+unexpected and pass=koala_metadata+runtime+declared. Do NOT relax any blocking that was previously blocked for non-passing categories.
items.userSees: User runs koala story_advance --phase=TEST --storyId=B-4b22 on a worktree where only .koala/story/actives/B-4b22/findings.json is dirty; DONE pre-check git-working-tree row reports: status=pass detail=pass: blocking=0 (material+fixture+unexpected); passed=1 (koala_metadata_changes=1). With packages/main/src/foo.ts modified (material_source_changes=1), same row reports: status=fail detail=fail: blocking=1 (material_source_changes=1); passed=0. Same evaluator output drives validation-executor side-effect guard wording.

validation-executor side-effect guard reports allPass when only passing categories dirty; audit lines appended to result.details

items.title: Add audit logging when a category is allowed to pass
items.context: When the policy says a category passes (koala_metadata / runtime / declared), record an audit line into the story's process events / activity log: which category, which paths, which command. This is the regression evidence that proves the gate did not silently swallow a real problem.
items.userSees: After every gate decision that lets ≥1 path pass, .koala/story/actives/B-4b22/process-events.jsonl gains one line: {"type":"dirty_gate_audit","storyId":"B-4b22","gate":"done-gate"|"test-pre-check"|"validate-side-effect","category":"koala_metadata_changes","pathCount":N,"paths":["<=5 sample paths"],"reason":"<auditReason from policy>","timestamp":"<ISO>"}. One audit entry per allowed category per gate invocation. User runs koala session_brief and sees recent activity references dirty_gate_audit.

happy.desc: Each gate that lets a category pass writes one structured line per category to .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/process-events.jsonl with type=dirty_gate_audit

edge.desc: When no category passes (all blocking or empty), no dirty_gate_audit line is written
paths field is truncated to 5 samples + pathCount stays accurate when category has >5 paths

adversarial.desc: If process-events.jsonl append fails (fs error), gate falls back to BLOCKING and surfaces AUDIT WRITE FAILED in output — never silent pass (preMortem #2 anchor)

verificationEvidence.note: validation-protocol-smoke passingPollutionRoot fixture asserts 2 audit lines (koala_metadata + runtime_artifact) in .koala/story/actives/B-pass/process-events.jsonl with type=dirty_gate_audit

items.title: Regression-prove blocking semantics for material/fixture/unexpected stay intact
items.context: Add smoke coverage where a worktree has 1 material_source_changes path + 1 fixture_changes path + 1 unexpected_dirty_files path simultaneously. TEST pre-check, DONE gate, and validate side-effect guard MUST still return blocking and produce hints naming all three categories. Separately assert that a worktree with only koala_metadata_changes (after Story 2 auto-commit) and declared_artifact_changes (after B-cf60 declaration) passes with audit lines.
